title: EUCR-2C - Electronic undercurrent relay, 2 CT, non-fail-safe, 0.5–60 A
description: Older analogue EUCR electronic undercurrent relay — the two-CT version, headed simply EUCR in the catalog and known as the 2C alongside its three-CT sibling. Protects pumps and driven loads against under-load and dry running. Non-fail-safe (normally de-energized) operation with a 1-SPDT (1C) changeover output. Current setting 0.5–60 A across three body types, or up to 600 A using the 05 type with external CTs.

rows: 100–600 : 05 type fitted to external CT (current ratio 100/5 A – 600/5 A)
Power supply voltage : 24 V AC/DC, 110 V AC, 220 V AC
Contact rating : 3 A / 250 V AC resistive
